Episode 166. Traces of the Caldron Snowfield (3)
Jin's hand, holding the red hair, was slightly trembling. He moved towards the cave interior, tucking the hair into his pocket.
Zephyrin was also about to finish tidying up the outside. The knights who were originally against her didn't have the ability to fight against such a dragon.
"Heh, that unlucky demon dragon is quite strong, seems like it's almost over. If things go well, Hedo might lose too?"
"It's not over yet, Sandra Zipple."
"Is that so? It looks like the cleaning is done."
"Reinforcements are coming."
Sandra tilted her head, looking at Hedo as if not understanding what he was saying.
"What do you mean? 12th trainee."
"Try to concentrate for a moment, tower keeper. At first, I thought only the souls near the cave were concentrated, but as soon as the battle started, I could faintly feel other souls from far away."
Hedo, who closed his eyes and heightened his senses, soon showed a surprised look.

He could also feel a very faint new energy. It was so small, like seeing a small bug hiding in the grass, one could never perceive it without confidently searching for its existence. Especially in the snowstorm of the Caldron snowfield.
"So... you're saying you felt this without concentrating particularly?"

"I've been sensitive to the spirit energy for a while. Not just from one place, it's coming from all around the snowfield. They will probably reach here within an hour. Moreover, there will be more reinforcements behind them."
If the spirit energy is faintly felt from a distance over an hour away, the scale of it when met up close will undoubtedly be massive.
"Tower keeper, can you inform Zephyrin about the situation and get her here?"
At that, a light flashed in Sandra's eyes.
"Go quickly, quickly! And try to come back as late as possible."
As soon as Hedo left his place for a moment, Sandra was overjoyed to be left alone with Jin in this cave.
Moreover, Jin was walking very slowly.
Of course, that was to examine this cave, where Valeria disappeared, as carefully as possible from the beginning, but Sandra decided not to think so.
"Thinking about it, it's the first time I'm walking alone with Mr. Jin like this. It's so nice...?"
Jin was so focused on observing the inside of the cave that he didn't even hear her words. Sandra chatted for a while and then grabbed Jin's shoulder.
"Mr. Jin, is she a very precious person?"
"Yes. You're asking an obvious question."
"That hair might not be hers. So, don't be too hasty."
"This is the hair of the person we're looking for."
"How can you be sure?"
"Because the color is unusual."
Of course, Valeria isn't the only one in the world with red hair.
However, Jin clearly recognized that it was Valeria's hair, an area that was hard to explain in words.
"If I get kidnapped somewhere next time, will you come looking for me like this?"
"It would depend on the situation."
"You're cold, but cool, so I forgive you. But even if you say that, I believe you'll come to rescue me."
"I don't want to go through this again. So always stay with the tower keeper."
Sandra writhed in emotion, while Jin continued to observe the inside.
'I can't see anything unusual yet, as Lonil said....'
The cave was not very deep. Even though he felt like he had reached halfway in just a few minutes, Jin could not find anything special.
From then on, Sandra also stopped chattering and started examining the cave thoroughly for Jin.
'The knights were always present, leaving some residual energy, but after Valeria disappeared, the Garden of Swords didn't interfere any further.'
It's a land where an important person disappeared, but they only deployed personnel and didn't touch anything at all.
What this fact implied was clear.

"Perhaps Runcandel... no, the Garden of Swords seems to be very cautious about this place. They didn't even dig or collapse the inner walls, even though Hister disappeared. The icicles are all intact too. They must be decades, hundreds of years old."
"I was thinking the same."
"Didn't you say that Runcandel's ancestral tomb is a subspace? I think they might have been looking for a way to enter that subspace. That is, if they know Runcandel is a subspace."
"That's a plausible story."
When they finally reached the end of the cave, Heddo, who had gone to inform Jephilin, returned.
"Ah, why are you back already! We were having such a good, quiet time, you muscle-brained!"
"Everything has been sorted out over there, and Jephilin said she would scout precisely first. Moreover, she said she would delay the arrival of the troops as much as possible, or annihilate them."
"I understand, tower keeper."
If Jephilin does that, it will take more time for the additional troops to arrive, but it was hard to gauge how much longer that would be.
The end of the cave was a hollow. It was full of transparent ice screens, like salt crystals, none of which had been broken and reformed.

"Lonil's statement that there was only one exit was correct. To get out of here, we have to go back the way we came, or break the ice wall... hmm, now I understand why the family couldn't find the Hister survivor even though they were tracking him."
Even when Jin and Sandra continued to search for the residual magical reaction in the cave, nothing special stood out.
The blue window of the recorded magic that Ronil had seen was also gone. It's natural since the caster disappeared.
'Before she disappeared from here, Valeria had been out of contact for about two months......and she left no clue about Tikan's Tomb of Temar.'
Then, Valeria must have been in such a desperate situation that she couldn't even contact Tikan during those two months.
And she disappeared without a trace right at this point. A little bit of her hair was shaved off.
'...Though Ronil did not properly meet with his teacher, it is certain that the Knights of Rosa had a battle with Valeria.'
After fleeing from that battle, Valeria must have found this cave. Ronil was pursuing such a Valeria, and so was Luntia.
No matter how he combined the information he heard from Ronil, the case only became more blurred.
More than ten minutes have already passed.
"12th successor, I suspect this is a trap. Rosa Runcandel must have expected you to come here."
"Probably so."

"Then she should have deployed more troops, prepared a surprise attack as soon as we entered, or Rosa Runcandel herself should have appeared. Don't you get the feeling that Rosa Runcandel is deliberately giving you time?"
Jin nodded. He, too, had been keeping that in mind.
"As the tower keeper says, the Tomb of Temar, which is expected to be here. She may be guessing and waiting that I have a way to enter."
Suddenly, the image of Paddler Runcandel crossed Jin's mind.
'Paddler was likely the guardian of the fifth tomb. But if the Prophet took Paddler out of the tomb, he has been in the fifth tomb at least once.'
But why is Rosa giving me time as if she wants me to find this?
'Is it because Valeria is still in the tomb? The Prophet, who came out of the tomb for some reason, doesn't know how to go back in.'
The problem is that Jin also doesn't know how to enter the tomb. It's neither like the first tomb, which has a key, nor does it have guides.
Time was passing cruelly fast.
"12th successor."
"Speak, tower keeper."
"It will be difficult for us to come back here. If it turns out that you have no other way, Rosa will completely block this place. So, how about we quickly try what they didn't do and leave?"
"Do you mean to destroy the cave?"
"Yes. There doesn't seem to be anything else to try."
"I will not destroy the cave. Even if I return today without any harvest, I do not want to eliminate even the slightest reason to come back in the future."
"So you intend to keep staying like this? You need to be cold-hearted."
From Hedo's point of view, it was more important to keep Sandra out of danger than to find Hister.
Especially in a situation as hopeless as this.
"Hedo! She's a very important person to Jin. Come up with something more innovative!"
"Doing something seems better than doing nothing, miss."
Hedo was right.
If it seemed like no further gains could be made, it was necessary to return and reevaluate the search as soon as possible.
"Let's try one last method and if it doesn't work, we'll go back."
"You've thought well. What's the method?"
"I'll fill the cave with spirit energy. If there's no response, we'll withdraw without further delay."
Jin sat down and unleashed his spirit energy. In the past, Murakan also injected a large amount of spirit energy in this way when using the key to the first tomb.
'Maybe the space itself is a key that responds to spirit energy. Please open...!'
In fact, if spirit energy was needed, it couldn't be possible that Valeria had entered the tomb.
Jin was just clutching at straws.
Spirit energy quickly filled the inside of the cave.
But even as Jin released a massive amount of spirit energy, enough to make him break into a cold sweat in an instant, there was no response.
Sandra, who had been watching, bit her nails and abruptly turned to Hedo.
"Hedo, do something more."
"There doesn't seem to be anything I can help with. I'm not a spirit energy user, miss."
"Then pray at least! Don't just stand there."
"Pray, you say?"
"Yes, pray sincerely. Pray for Jin to find Hister."
Sandra closed her eyes and clasped her hands together. Hedo sighed deeply at the sight of her and took the same position next to her.
He thought it was a ridiculous act, but he had no choice because if he didn't, she would make a fuss.
And it was right then that Jin felt a sudden shock as if he had been hit in the back of the head.
'Spirit energy is being absorbed all at once...!'
This was the first sign of change.
Jin immediately turned his gaze to where the spirit energy was converging. It was right where Sandra and Hedo were standing side by side in prayer.
"Hedo! Your sword! The sword is glowing and creating something, it's as if the heavens are responding to our prayers!"
"I see it too, miss. What the heck..."
Jin was overwhelmed by a strong intuition.
Hedo's sword might be the key leading to Temar's fifth tomb.
